canonical_statement: Let Omega be a nonempty bounded connected open subset of a finite-dimensional real Euclidean space. If u is real-valued, continuous on closure(Omega), and harmonic on Omega, then every value of u on closure(Omega) is at most the maximum of u on the frontier of Omega.
domain_and_universes: Provisional: finite-dimensional real Euclidean domain; exact Lean ambient type and universe are not frozen
quantifiers: Omega: nonempty bounded connected open domain
conclusion: u(x) is at most the maximum of u over frontier(Omega)

alternate_encodings.target: maximum of u on closure(Omega) is attained on frontier(Omega)

excluded_or_boundary_cases: Unbounded domains, functions lacking boundary continuity, and the strong interior-maximum conclusion are outside the root. Empty domains are excluded. Dimension-zero and empty-frontier behavior require explicit mutation tests.
